description: A webpack plugin to load lynx external bundles.

exports.name: ExternalsLoadingPlugin
exports.summary: The webpack plugin to load lynx external bundles.

members.name: backgroundLayer
members.summary: The name of the background layer.

members.name: externals
members.summary: Specify the externals to be loaded. The externals should be Lynx Bundles.

members.name: globalObject
members.summary:
This option indicates what global object will be used to mount the library.

In Lynx, the library will be mounted to `lynx[Symbol.for("__LYNX_EXTERNAL_GLOBAL__")]` by default.

If you have enabled share js context and want to reuse the library by mounting to the global object, you can set this option to `'globalThis'`.

members.name: mainThreadLayer
members.summary: The name of the main thread layer.

members.name: retries
members.summary: The number of additional attempts when fetching the external bundle times out (`response.code === -2`).

members.name: timeout
members.summary: The timeout in milliseconds for loading the externals.

exports.name: ExternalValue
exports.summary: The value item of the externals.

members.name: async
members.summary: Whether the source should be loaded asynchronously or not.

members.name: background
members.summary: The options of the background layer.

members.name: bundlePath
members.summary:
The bundle path resolved against the runtime public path.

Prefer this over `url` when the bundle should follow the active
`publicPath`. The runtime will load it with `publicPath + bundlePath`,
which keeps external bundle resolution aligned with the current build
output without hard-coding an absolute URL into the generated runtime code.

members.name: libraryName
mainThread
members.summary: The options of the main-thread layer.

members.name: retries
members.summary: The number of additional attempts when fetching the external bundle times out (`response.code === -2`).

members.name: url
members.summary:
The final bundle URL to fetch directly at runtime.

Use this when the external bundle is hosted outside the current build
output, such as on a CDN. If both `url` and `bundlePath` are provided,
`url` takes precedence because it is already the fully resolved address.

exports.name: LayerOptions
exports.summary: The options of the background or main-thread layer.
